**What and why**

**How it was tested**
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test` (tests added for the change)

**Docs**
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] README (test counts, environment variables) if changed
- [ ] `SECURITY.md`, `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md` and the privacy notice if an outside service was added
